pages.title: Automatic Patches
pages.text: AuramCore also patches selected vanilla and modded paths to reduce avoidable chunk waits, repeated terrain work and expensive item comparisons.$(br2)These patches apply automatically when their target mods are present. Auram’s common config does not expose individual on/off switches for them.

pages.title: Gameplay Boundaries
pages.text: The terrain patches aim to retain structure placement rules and random draws while avoiding repeated work. They do not add a world preset, new ores, or a new dimension.$(br2)Local fixture benchmarks are not a promise of the same speedup in every world. Pack recipes, starter gear, map stages and other mods’ mechanics remain separate from these patches.
